remarks: Welcome to this delightful 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom duplex perfectly situated moments from the heart of New Canaan's town center. Just a 5 minute driving distance to the train station makes this home a commuter's dream! The layout features a spacious living room, a kitchen that overlooks the dining area, and three comfortable bedrooms. Enjoy the added convenience of a private laundry area and one-car garage parking off of large shared driveway. This bright and spacious home provides the perfect combination of comfort, functionality, and convenience. ideal for those seeking a peaceful yet accessible lifestyle just moments from the heart of New Canaan.
